source_mapping: Authoritative /spec/source.txt is formalized in Research/Submission.lean. exactProductTree maps each real pair to its exact product; roundedProductTree maps each pair to Model.mul; roundedDotProduct applies roundedSum to roundedProductTree. The target quantifies over every Model and every Tree (ℝ × ℝ), assumes only (((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1), and asserts a same-shaped leafwise IsPerturbation of exactProductTree with bound gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u whose exactSum equals roundedDotProduct. All five supplied prerequisite modules were copied byte-for-byte to matching Research paths. Feedback/revisions: /spec/feedback.json was absent; no statement revision was required.
